card.name: End of intrauterine and in utero
card.fires_on: The last piece of 'intrauterine' (-ine) or 'in utero' (-ero), when it is split into parts, in pregnancy and fetal exposure warnings.

modes.label: intrauterine
modes.description: The ending 'ine' of 'intrauterine' before exposure or growth retardation.
modes.example: congenital anomalies were observed following intrauter<<ine>> exposure to statins.

modes.label: in utero
modes.description: The ending 'ero' of 'in utero' before 'exposure to' a named drug.
modes.example: Closely observe infants with histories of in ut<<ero>> exposure to captopril for hypot
